type_profile.distinction: Three-masted 44-gun frigate with one complete enclosed battery and partial guns on the raised quarterdeck/forecastle; long fine hull, moderate castles.
type_profile.rationale: The guide links port spacing and working length to gun count. The main enclosed row plus separate upper castle groups makes this 44-gun frigate structurally distinct from the corvette and two-battery battleship.
type_profile.forecastle_port_note: The upper fore gun-port after edge lies 0.46 m forward of the forecastle break, keeping the entire rectangular opening within the raised forebody.

scope.delivered: Static duel asset with two paint variants and LOD/collision/review assets.
scope.engine_integration: Not integrated with an engine: no buoyancy, damage, artillery, sailing or crew controllers.
scope.walking: Authored geometric passage and stair access; no player controller or engine navigation integration. Actual clearance checks are recorded in validation.json after build.
scope.interiors: Modelled structural interiors with real planked decks, frames, hatch apertures, stairs and cabin partition openings. Layout is an authored reconstruction, not recovered retail geometry.

evidence.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: Endymion (1797), ZAZ2228
evidence.kind: Primary builder plan for the Admiralty
evidence.observed: The museum identifies a 1:48 lower-deck plan of the 40-gun frigate Endymion, made by Randall, Brent and Sons.
evidence.application: A continuous principal battery deck below the open upper waist, with after accommodation and real fore/aft access.
evidence.limit: Endymion is a later 40-gun analogue; POTC family total remains 44 and its authored battery allocation is preserved.

evidence.title: Association Hermione-La Fayette: Chirurgie Marine, deuxième partie
evidence.observed: The article places the crew and surgeon in the between-deck space beneath the battery and above the hold, with temporary framed/canvas sick-berths and storage.
evidence.application: Add a separate berth deck below the principal battery, with framed timber and a clear central passage.
evidence.limit: Modern replica operation and later French practice are arrangement analogues; no claim about original game room locators.

evidence.title: Association Hermione-La Fayette: Cloisonnement du faux-pont, la Sainte-Barbe
evidence.observed: The account separates a partitioned after between-deck room from the powder magazine below it in the hold.
evidence.application: A physically partitioned after store and lower powder store, with passage openings instead of a solid wall across the route.
evidence.limit: Magazine and aft store are original static scenery; they are not interactive ammunition systems or exact Hermione room copies.

notes: One principal enclosed battery plus the preserved light upper extremity batteries give exactly 44 guns. The between-deck berth space and hold follow documented frigate hierarchy. The after cabin is abaft the last principal gun station; no second full principal battery is invented.
